rules.text: Be respectful to everyone in the community
subItems: No racism, sexism, homophobic, transphobic or xenophobic remarks, joking or not.
If you have an opinion, say it respectfully and back it up with reason. Refrain from insults and trash talking.
No unrelated and/or out-of-context memes. If it does not contribute to the current conversation in a channel, do not post it.
No spamming. This includes, but is not limited to, meaningless text, emoji, images, or advertisements.

rules.text: Keep images and discussion in their respective categories and channels
subItems: No pornographic or suggestive material or discussion outside of the NSFW channel category. If you have to ask yourself, if what you want to post is NSFW, the answer is yes.

rules.text: Be mindful of a few taboos
subItems: Politics are strictly banned. Political discussions never end well and no one leaves happy.
Do not spoil any kind of media, no matter its age. Simply use spoiler tags. <command>||spoiler here||</>
Do <u>not</u> ping the Zootopian Police role except for emergencies such as a raid or troll. You may always ping or DM individual ZPD members when needed.

rules.text: Keep account usernames and avatars clean
subItems: No (overtly) offensive and/or NSFW avatars. Cropped NSFW images are fine as long as the avatar itself is SFW.
Keep illegible and/or obstructing characters in usernames and chat messages to an absolute minimum. Either your username or nickname must consist entirely of the modern Latin Alphabet.

otherRules: Always respect Discord's Terms of Service and do not try to abuse or exploit any of the bots.

policeRules.text: These rules are enforced by ZPD interpretation and discretion.
The ZPD will provide a rationale for any actions taken but their decisions are final.
The ZPD have full discretion to:
subItems: remove content or users deemed unpleasant or unwelcome by community members.
take action if the rules are pushed or bent, including openly arguing over punishments or instructions.

policeRules.text: Ban appeals may be sent via email to zpd (at) zootopiadiscord (dot) com at any time. Please include your Discord username and tag (User#0420) and open friend requests so we can get back to you directly.
